purpose: Freeze the three complementary public-data experiments, their task-specific baselines, metric boundaries, and failure-prevention gates for Paper 1

shared_response_stack.task_specific_retrieval_boundary: Response MP/MS/ME/RS routing comparisons share their response retrievers. ES-MemEval official session-RAG and raw/full-history baselines retain their predeclared task-specific representations and retrievers because they are representation baselines, not alternate PM policies.

whole_response_generation_gate.required: The generator receives the typed response program and literal authorized evidence before generation and emits one coherent user-visible reply plus a private structured evidence-use trace.
forbidden: visible MP/MS/ME/RS labels or resource IDs
claiming requested evidence was used solely because it appeared in the prompt

ESConv_response.role_in_proof_chain: single-session RS routing, immediate support quality, explicit boundaries, and the no-longitudinal-memory mask
ESConv_response.data: all 169 official test dialogues, one state each; Strategy Bank derives only from quarantined-clean train lineage; validation is development-only and does not enter the final response denominator

resource_mask.RS: eligible through the same frozen six-card bank and response retriever used in EvoEmo

primary_questions: Does the PM keep memory bits OFF when longitudinal memory is unavailable?
Does RS activation improve or preserve immediate support without violating explicit listen/advice/burden boundaries?
Does learned RS beat always-off and transparent/fixed/cost-matched alternatives on the quality-risk-cost tradeoff?
primary_metrics: generation input tokens and USD cost

EvoEmo_longitudinal_response.role_in_proof_chain: longitudinal typed-memory routing, evidence integration, grounding, continuity, interaction, and cost transport
EvoEmo_longitudinal_response.data: all 18 users and the pre-existing 204-state response panel; all policy predictions are user-held-out/cross-fitted
EvoEmo_longitudinal_response.visible_history: same-user strictly-prior sessions only; current unclosed summary/observation, future sessions, other users, QA fields, and hindsight-only top-level summaries are denied
primary_questions: Can MP profile/constraint, MS continuity/observation, and available ME action-result candidates be selected conditionally?
Does the typed executor absorb selected evidence into one natural response with correct owner/time/epistemic framing?
Does learned PM preserve quality and risk while reducing evidence and token cost relative to fixed-high?
At which stage do failures originate?
primary_metrics: oracle-set inclusion and policy regret where the 16-action panel supplies a resolved oracle
generation input tokens and USD cost
cannot_prove: MP preference when the public source contains no such resource
natural coverage of every one of 16 actions

ES_MemEval_QA.role_in_proof_chain: memory retrieval, information extraction, temporal reasoning, conflict detection, user modeling, and abstention
ES_MemEval_QA.data: official public v1.0.0 artifact: all 1,427 questions across all 18 users
ES_MemEval_QA.official_release_note: The public artifact count is used; it is not relabeled as an exact reproduction of the paper's 1,209-question selection without that selection manifest.
generator_visible: condition-authorized same-user history or typed candidates
objective_metrics: BERTScore F1 using bert-score==0.3.13 and bert-base-uncased without baseline rescaling
macro results over all questions and each capability
abstention accuracy and should-abstain false-answer rate
session Recall@4 and nDCG@4 only on deterministically mappable evidence questions
ES_MemEval_QA.llm_judge: optional robustness diagnostic only; never training gold and never a replacement for Token F1/BERTScore
ES_MemEval_QA.interpretation: cross-task transport diagnostic for retrieval and QA; not response QRC and not proof that all four response heads learned

leakage_and_shortcut_gates.qa_gold_changes_query_retrieval_pm_or_pr: must be false under a negative-canary test
leakage_and_shortcut_gates.shared_session_id_rule: session primary key is (user_id, session_id); users sharing a raw session ID remain in the same fold
leakage_and_shortcut_gates.ESConv_seed_quarantine: all 84 ESConv dialogues used in EvoEmo lineage remain excluded from RS train/evaluation overlap

historical_failure_prevention.treatment_identity_drift: content-address every state, candidate, prompt, runner, generator, evaluator, and policy condition
historical_failure_prevention.pseudoreplication: cluster by user for longitudinal/QA and dialogue for ESConv; never use states, seeds, judge orders, or aliases as independent users
historical_failure_prevention.candidate_retriever_pm_conflation: mandatory stagewise responsibility ledger and actual-Rank1-only execution
historical_failure_prevention.requested_realized_conflation: report requested, received, used, functional, realized, and fallback separately
historical_failure_prevention.semantic_pseudo_gold: no construction condition, regex, candidate presence, UNKNOWN, or external prevalence may become an ON/OFF label
historical_failure_prevention.posthoc_append: whole-response generation gate; appended evidence clauses are a hard protocol failure
historical_failure_prevention.outcome_informed_repair: after this freeze, report failures and fail closed; do not change states, representations, prompts, thresholds, or denominators
historical_failure_prevention.qa_gold_leakage: evaluator-only mapping is joined only after predictions are immutable

execution_order: complete all six formal effect folds and repair transport failures only
freeze formal OOF head predictions or fail each head closed
run the 32-48 common-state all-16-action interaction/oracle panel
freeze external manifests, unique prompt hashes, and evaluator-only QA mapping
execute ESConv response, EvoEmo response, and ES-MemEval QA under one V5.3 release
score and report all three tracks without method feedback
stop_rule: Once any formal or external outcome is opened, only deterministic transport repair with identical state, prompt, seed, endpoint, and archived failure is allowed; all scientific method changes require a new named version.
